chapters.label: Live: the 2026 final
chapters.text: The 2026 Futsal Euro final: Spain against Portugal, with Dídac Plana in goal. Spain win, five goals to three! He is famous for lightning saves.

chapters.label: How he saves (demo)
chapters.text: This is how he saves. He stays up on his toes, knees soft, hands ready. The shot comes, and he snaps out a leg. Blocked!

chapters.label: From behind him (demo)
chapters.text: From behind him: the ball is so close, there is no time to dive. Quick feet and quick hands win it.

chapters.label: Stay on your toes
chapters.text: Now you: stay on your toes, so you can react fast to shots from close range!
